quest.title: The Crux Clash
quest.description: After meeting some of the contestants, you reckon that this will be a milk run. Still, your ticket to Inazuma is at stake here. Best not to let your guard down during the tournament.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x750, Mora x35475, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Talk to Zhuhan, who is in charge of registration for The Crux Clash
Take part in the tournament and win

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I knew I wouldn't regret introducing you as the favorite!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #So what do you think, Kazuha? {F#She}{M#He} totally dominated that guy, and did it with style, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Impressive. But I also observed our favorite exercise some restraint, as if to protect the opponent from serious harm.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #Well, I've fought my fair share of battles, both big and small. And I say, after the show {F#she}{M#he} put on just now, {F#she}{M#he}'s more than convinced me of {F#her}{M#his} ability.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So come on, we all know you've got a wide vocabulary in there — can't you spare a word or two to congratulate our up-and-coming champion?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Alright... Let me think how to aptly phrase these words of praise...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...You fought well.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ugh, alright then. I was thinking your inner poet might want to join in the fun, but... I guess I shouldn't put you on the spot like that.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: You know, a lot of competitors came to me saying how surprised they were that Liyue's hero was entering the tournament...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: ...And since you signed up, we've had many others do the same, with more than a few top-tier fighters among them. I'm sure lots of them are here to find out how they stack up against you.

choices.text: Didn't know I was so popular...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Haha, well, since everyone sees you as the one to beat, I figured I should start treating you that way, too.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: For one thing, we don't want you wasting all your energy in the early rounds fighting people who are well below your level. Not to mention... you must be itching to fight someone in your league, too, right?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: So, I'm putting you straight through to the semi-finals!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? But we only just started the qualifiers... Seems like a crazy system if we just skip straight to the semi-finals.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: This is how Captain Beidou works. You won't persuade her otherwise.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Besides, at your level, you would have made it to the semi-finals anyway.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. To be fair, Paimon was thinking that too...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Alright, I'm gonna watch some more of the tournament. If there's any potential contenders for you out there, I want to know who they are and what they're about.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: We're finally here, folks! The real show is about to begin!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hehe... the captain seems to have high hopes for this tournament. I have not seen her so excited in quite some time.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Your opponent has fought many rounds to get to the semi-finals. This makes him a seasoned warrior.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: You may well be stronger than him, but this should not give you cause to lower your guard.

choices.text: I won't.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Very well. Show me that you are ready to push through the storm that lies ahead.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Alright, that's enough chit-chat for now. The audience is waiting. Go find the crew member that signed you up, she'll take you into the arena.

choices.text: I haven't forgotten why I'm here.
I don't see what all the fuss is about.

talks.objective: Talk to Zhuhan again and enter the next round

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: Your opponent in the semi-finals is new to The Crux Clash, but he has quickly become the dark horse of the tournament.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuhan
dialogues.text: I do not doubt your abilities, but I would suggest that you make sure you are fully prepared before you begin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Relax! My {F#girl}{M#guy}'s at the top of {F#her}{M#his} game, {F#she}{M#he} ain't gonna lose!

choices.text: I'm ready.

response.speaker: Zhuhan
response.text: Okay. Follow me.

choices.text: Interesting... getting a few butterflies over here.

response.speaker: Zhuhan
response.text: Don't worry, take some time to compose yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Rongshi
dialogues.text: I'm sweating all over. It's a good feeling.

dialogues.speaker: Rongshi
dialogues.text: Congratulations, I was beaten by the best. I need to train harder.

choices.text: You fought very well yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! For a moment there, Paimon was a little worried...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you had a Vision, you'd definitely be one of the strongest around.

response.speaker: Rongshi
response.text: I wanted a Vision, once, when I was a kid. People said that if you're strong enough you'll have your chance to get one.

response.speaker: Rongshi
response.text: But mine never came.

response.speaker: Rongshi
response.text: I lost interest, eventually. You can't depend on a Vision like you can your own body.

response.speaker: Rongshi
response.text: I've fought and won against Vision bearers before. The power they have was given to them by the gods. I don't envy it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You mean, you didn't sign up to try and get your hands on that Masterless Vision?

response.speaker: Rongshi
response.text: No, I didn't. I only wanted to pit myself against other fighters and see who was the strongest.

response.speaker: Rongshi
response.text: Only in defeat can you understand your weaknesses and learn from them. So, I'm pleased with today's outcome. I don't often have the pleasure of experiencing defeat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... now that's true strength talking!

response.speaker: Rongshi
response.text: If you have the chance in the future, please come and spar with me again. I will be stronger next time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So will I.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By the way... do you know who else made it into the finals? ...Is it gonna be someone even tougher than you?

response.speaker: Rongshi
response.text: Whether they'll be as tough as me I don't know... But what I have heard is that they're extremely quick.

response.speaker: Rongshi
response.text: So don't get too cocky.

choices.text: I believe you have the potential to be champion.

talks.objective: Ask around for info about your final opponent

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Yun
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you, haha! I watched your match. What a stunning performance!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Yun
dialogues.text: I myself was eliminated in the third round. *sigh* Shame... If only I could have advanced one more round...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, maybe next time, huh? By the way, do you happen to know who else advanced to the final round?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Yun
dialogues.text: Why, yes. He's the same one who defeated me. He is a formidable opponent, quick on his feet and swift to take advantage of his opponent's missteps.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Yun
dialogues.text: I faltered for but a brief moment, but before I knew it, he had me on the floor.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Yun
dialogues.text: Given my stature, I have no fear of squaring off with physically strong opponents. But faced with a nimble, agile opponent such as him... I found myself completely out of my league...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Yun
dialogues.text: Still — I'm sure he'll be no match for you, haha!

talks.objective: Continue asking around for more info about your final opponent

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there... uh, but where did the other guy go?

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: He tried to use force dispersal to deflect a punch, but instead he took it straight to the nose. There was blood all over the place...

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: His opponent was pretty freaked out by it. He kept asking him "why didn't you dodge?" But he was pretty much out cold by that point and couldn't reply.

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: "Why don't you dodge?" they ask... Because to not dodge is the very essence of Lingshan Clan kung fu. It's just that he hadn't quite mastered it yet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did your match go?

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: Don't even get me started... I spent all my energy helping him get from here to the boat to take him back to the harbor. But by the time I got back, my scheduled match time had already passed, and I had to forfeit.

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: I don't dare tell my master about this... Otherwise, I'd never hear the end of it.

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: Sorry, I shouldn't be complaining in front of you like this. I'm afraid I'm still a bit out of sorts at the moment, so I probably won't be able to help you with whatever you were here to ask me about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, alright then... hope your buddy makes a swift recovery. Hang in there!

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: Thanks, I'll do my best...

talks.objective: Ask Beidou and Kazuha about your final opponent

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You gave an outstanding performance. Truly commendable.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I could sense that you are not familiar with bouts of this kind, and it could have cost you the match.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But you were quick to adapt, and managed to claim victory over your opponent. That is a most invaluable skill.

choices.text: You have a keen eye.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: In fact, I discerned this not from what I saw, but what I heard — the ground beneath your feet and the pattern of your breathing. But it is nothing remarkable, for I discerned nothing more than Captain Beidou did.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Ahaha, he's right. But in my case, I was purely relying on previous experience.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I guess not using your elemental powers must be quite new for you, huh?

choices.text: It sure is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We wanted to ask about who our opponent will be in the final round. Do you think they'll be stronger than the one we faced in the semi-finals?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Not exactly. Contenders that reach the finals aren't necessarily "stronger," they tend to have something unique about their style.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: As for the guy you'll be facing, his skill lies in his speed, and he has superior form. It's also obvious that he's seen his fair share of battles.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: What's the matter? Worried that you've bitten off more than you can chew this time?

choices.text: Better to be safe than sorry.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If that is the case, then I have a proposal for you. Let's go somewhere a little quieter, shall we?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I haven't properly introduced myself yet. In the land of Inazuma, I was a wandering samurai.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, yeah, we could tell that from your getup. But at the same time... When you talk, you don't really sound like someone who's used to waving a sword around...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It is true that I am versed both in literary and martial traditions. But on the straggling path of a wandering samurai, is there harm in acquiring a surplus skill?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I do not mean to flaunt my martial prowess, but I myself have witnessed reputable fighters hailing from across the lands. I do possess some knowledge regarding your opponent's particular skillset.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Given your talents, a few hints from me will be all that's necessary to bring your opponent down.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Hang on! Don't you think you're bending the rules a bit there?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Gathering intelligence is an essential part of any duel. You must know your enemy.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Besides, our favorite here has fought many battles on their journey from Mondstadt. Such impressive feats require more than just bravery alone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You betcha!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, wait a second. We never told you that we've been to Mondstadt!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hehe, does one not leave a trail when traveling through the wild? In return, nature also leaves its traces upon you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: However, there is only so much that can be discerned from these traces. I sense that many things about you elude me still... These are the things I am curious to know about.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Come with me. Some post-match entertainment is in order.

choices.text: It's vital that we make it to Inazuma.
Yeah, glad it's almost over!
You are very observant.

talks.objective: Follow Kazuha to a more peaceful location

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Now that we're alone, let me cut to the heart of the matter...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You are skilled in manipulating the elements. And not just a single element, but multiple. Is that correct?

choices.text: Ah, so you already know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon knew that you were hinting at something from the moment we met. You've known all along.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: That's right. If the other contenders were to catch wind of your elemental abilities, let's just say it would cause some unwanted misunderstandings.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If I'm not mistaken, you share these considerations, given your reluctance to use elemental skills even in the heat of a match.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes, but how did you know?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hehe, when I talk about that which I see or hear in you, this is not poetic symbolism at play. I mean these things in the truest sense possible.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Since a young age, I have been attuned to the tidings of nature. I hear the breath of the wind and the whispers of the leaves.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It is things of this nature that I also hear from within you, nothing more.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As crazy as all that sounds, somehow Paimon still believes you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: My humble abilities are negligible compared to your incredible feats.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: To think a human could wield the elements without a Vision...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: And not to mention your incredibly complex scent, like that of some mysterious being...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, stop evaluating us based on our smell! It's weird!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Could you perchance enlighten me as to how you managed to obtain your combined elemental abilities?

choices.text: I'm afraid I don't know either.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hmm, extraordinary.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: So then, might I be so bold as to inquire how exactly it is that you learned to channel elemental energy, and even wield it in combat?

choices.text: It's all thanks to Paimon's knowledge.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Aw, it's nothing, really. Paimon just told {F#her}{M#him} whatever came to mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #It's been a long journey, and many things have happened along the way. Somehow, {F#she}{M#he} just naturally learned to use the elements through it all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Honestly, even Paimon doesn't understand how it all works.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Perhaps such unfathomable things are the essence of the gods and the Visions they grant.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: However, I still wish to have the honor of seeing how you wield the elements, perhaps it may yet reveal something to me.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Of course, I too shall share with you all that I've learned. That will make it a fair exchange.

choices.text: Fair enough.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Now then, let's test your skills, shall we?

choices.text: Finally, a real battle.
It's all thanks to Paimon's companionship.
All I did was touch a Statue of The Seven.
No wonder you didn't bring this up at the arena.

talks.objective: Defeat the monsters to show Kazuha your elemental abilities

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm, your skills in battle are truly beyond reproach. Even with your opponent's speed, he shouldn't be able to overwhelm you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Your opponent is skilled at controlling his breathing and maintaining balance, which enables him to execute moves that many would find impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He relies entirely on the element of surprise to defeat his opponents.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: In other words, as long as you remain mindful of his ability to detect weak points, then his attacks should pose no threat to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you, I will not underestimate him.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Please, save your thanks. If anything, I should be thanking you for the opportunity to witness your command of the elements that defies all known principles.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The world is a truly mysterious place, it seems, and one will always encounter that which is still unknown.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You seem kinda obsessed with Visions... but don't you already have your own? Why are you so intent on exploring the connection between Visions and the elements?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I desire to know what meaning Visions have to the gods.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: And what influences the gods' decision to grant humans these Visions.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: My apologies, you must be completely in the dark regarding such matters.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: For allowing me the honor of witnessing your mystical ways, I am willing to answer any questions you may have regarding Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I am indeed in the dark, so please enlighten me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: So that's what you're curious about? Haha, then allow me to tell you more.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: As you well know, a Vision Hunt Decree is currently underway in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Visions are a gift bestowed by the divine. People that have accepted this gift are now having their Visions confiscated inexplicably, sometimes in circumstances that leave their original recipients dead.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: In the outset, supposing each of the Seven Archons had their criteria for granting Visions to living beings — then, does the current Electro Archon now doubt these criteria, or even the act in and of itself?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Not to mention, with no new Electro Visions having been granted for such a long time, it would seem that we can infer something of the Raiden Shogun's feelings on the matter...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She sounds less like an archon and more like... a tyrant.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: As far as I know, she is an archon that pursues "eternity." She will relentlessly carry out her will with no regard to what others may think or feel.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Liyue's "contracts" are meant to benefit all who reside within Liyue. But what does Inazuma's pursuit of "eternity" bring to its people?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...It goes without saying that the people locked within Inazuma do not fare well these days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds a lot like something the god you encountered in the beginning would do.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Oh? Have you encountered the Electro Archon before?

choices.text: I'm not sure.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: With time, we will change. But the shogun will remain the same.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If you wish to find her, she will forever be there.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: There will come a day when I too shall wish to understand the answers to "eternity" from her.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Ah! The time for your match is approaching.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! We got so distracted talking about Inazuma that Paimon forgot all about the tournament!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If you have no other matters to attend to, then we can return together.

choices.text: Sure, let's go together.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Very well, let's go. I wish to see who will obtain the Vision.

choices.text: I'll head back on my own shortly.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Very well. Just be sure to not be late for the match.

choices.text: It was already a long time ago now.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Kazuha has had his eye on you from the moment you arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: If you've got anything to ask him, this'll be your chance.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... You control the elements without a Vision, that means...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Oh, pay no attention to me, I was just talking to myself. Ahem... I will be sure to observe your battle intently.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: At last, the moment we've all been waiting for — the semi-finals have begun!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Who's it going to be this time — the hero, or the dark horse?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: The extraordinary prize is now but a step away for the victor!

dialogues.speaker: Rongshi
dialogues.text: I don't care about the prize...

dialogues.speaker: Rongshi
dialogues.text: You're a strong opponent. That's what I'm here for.

dialogues.speaker: Joyce
dialogues.text: Please exercise extreme caution. Do not touch the meteorites with your bare hands.

dialogues.speaker: Adler
dialogues.text: Please keep a safe distance from the meteorites. Only approach the impact site if you have business concerning the meteorites.

dialogues.speaker: Hartman
dialogues.text: Thank you all! I must get back to the Winery and let everyone know that I'm safe.

dialogues.speaker: Recuperated Victim
dialogues.text: Huh...? W—Was I asleep? ...Gosh, how long was I out?

dialogues.speaker: Edna
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon spare you from the effects of the meteorites.

dialogues.speaker: Yunjiang
dialogues.text: Leave the patrolling of the area to me! ...But as far as dealing with the meteorites goes, I've heard you're the ones who know what you're doing?

dialogues.speaker: Tiancheng
dialogues.text: I haven't had a moment's rest since the meteorite strikes started... Now I think about it, the sleepers don't have it so bad, do they?

dialogues.speaker: Lao Cai
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail. Please report any new incidents to me.

dialogues.speaker: Recuperated Victim
dialogues.text: *yawn* ...Hmm? What're you staring at me for?

dialogues.speaker: Recuperated Victim
dialogues.text: Now I'm awake, can I go back home? I just want to go home...

dialogues.speaker: Recuperated Victim
dialogues.text: I hear you've been clearing away the meteorites? Nice work! There's a lot to be said for being young and fit, I suppose!

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Meteorites, can you believe it... First time for everything, I guess!

dialogues.speaker: Huaqing
dialogues.text: Hey, who's that! ...Oh, you're the adventurers here to help out. Sorry. Your help is greatly appreciated.

dialogues.speaker: Bro Huang
dialogues.text: This has been a long shift... I'm getting hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Yang
dialogues.text: Something about watching these people sleeping is making me sleepy, too... Ahem! No, I would never sleep on the job!

dialogues.speaker: Gao the Sixth
dialogues.text: A bowl of piping hot food right after I woke up... Just what I needed!

dialogues.speaker: Check Victim
dialogues.text: The victim is still deep in sleep.
